name: paper-orchestra-codex
description: An evidence-first Codex workflow for preparing, auditing, and writing research papers with Google Research's PaperOrchestra.

interface.longDescription: Prepare traceable research material, audit inputs, and optionally run Google's PaperOrchestra multi-agent manuscript pipeline. Requires local Python and user-supplied model credentials for generation.
defaultPrompt: Use PaperOrchestra to audit the evidence in my research project before writing a paper.
Prepare a PaperOrchestra material bundle from my experiment logs and figures, but don't run paid models.
Use the PaperOrchestra writing workflow to draft a LaTeX manuscript from verified evidence. Show a dry-run first.
